v0.4.15 was a 7 days ago (2024-10-03) and didn't recieve it's own post since it was small. If you're interested in every patch note, along with the smaller details that aren't mentioned here, they're all in the Discord server

notes.title: v0.4.14 + Save Data corruption issues
notes.content:
- Fixed issues with save data corruption when Windows crashes (more info below)
- Rebalanced some endgame content
- Added "Element Missions" evil tree upgrade
- Added 2 ingame and Steam achievements
- Added a setting for displaying skins on window buttons
- Added a setting for pinning favorited windows
- Added a setting for displaying mission group name alongside the mission
- Added a fullscreen setting
- Added "Double Garden" in app purchase
- Fixed some typos
- Fixed some stats not showing
- Fixed "Auto Boxes" mission not requiring to auto smash
- Made it more difficult to click off Simon
- Changed some Mission descriptions to respect number format
- Changed all references of "ping pong" to "ping-pong"
- Changed Blueberry unlock to not be purchasable with buy max or Necromancy
- Changed names and descriptions of some settings
- Changed flavor text for some Mouse skins
- Clarified how to unlock more Challenges
- Added small hints for upcoming content

There has been issues with save data getting corrupted when windows crashes (e.g. power outage, bluescreen). The issue has been fixed, though the save data is not recoverable.
But, if you encountered this issue, you could ask some nice people in the discord server to share their save data if it's close to where you where (or ask me personally to generate a save).
Discord link - https://discord.gg/rmeGX2yRHa
